description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the SearchProperty interface, providing various methods to create search filters based on property paths, including equality, inequality, range, existence, and pattern matching filters. It encapsulates property path handling and filter creation logic for a term-based search system within a larger project.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchProperty
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the SearchProperty interface, providing factory methods and filter creation for property search.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableSearchProperty instance from a JsonPointer.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates an equality filter for various data types (boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a not-equal filter for various data types.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a greater-than or equal filter for various data types.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a greater-than filter for various data types.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a less-than or equal filter for various data types.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a less-than filter for various data types.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a pattern-matching filter with a string pattern.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates an 'in' filter with multiple values for various data types.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the property path.
